subject: Re: MAP — Acme production rollout & sign-off
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Emily Johnson <emily.johnson@acme.com>, Luke Peterson <luke.peterson@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + post-call recap (Acme rollout)

Hi Emily / Luke — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps (draft MAP attached):

- Goal: Launch Acme customer support assistant on Acme Help Center (Phase 1) by target go-live date.
- Target close date: 2026-06-25 (contract signature); proposed go-live: 2026-07-06.
- Key milestones (draft):
  1) Contract & SOW finalization — Redwood / Acme legal — target 6/25
  2) Provisioning & network setup (VPC peering + KMS) — Acme infra (owner: Luke) / Redwood infra — target 6/28
  3) Integration & data connectors (Zendesk export / embeddings) — Acme eng / Redwood integration — target 6/30
  4) Staging validation & quality gates (success criteria below) — joint validation — target 7/02
  5) Go-live & rollout — target 7/06

Responsibilities are noted in the attached MAP (Acme_Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf). Success criteria (draft):
- 90th percentile latency < 500ms for production traffic profiles;
- End-to-end test coverage with sample queries showing >= 85% accuracy on canonical intents;
- KV/prompt cost estimate <= $0.012 per session (preview numbers).

Action items for Acme: please review the attached MAP and confirm (a) milestone owners, (b) any missing dependencies, and (c) whether target close date 6/25 is realistic. Legal has a separate redline link we can push to DocuSign once we have final sign-off.

Camila
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachment: Acme_Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP draft, milestones, responsibilities)

From: Emily Johnson <emily.johnson@acme.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Luke Peterson <luke.peterson@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + post-call recap (Acme rollout)

Thanks Camila — this is helpful. A couple quick notes from our side after reviewing:

- Success criteria: the 85% accuracy threshold looks good, but we want to add a security gate: SOC 2 evidence + encrypted at-rest confirmation before go-live. Luke, can infra confirm timeline?
- Milestone owners: we can own data connectors and staging validation but will need Redwood to lead provisioning (VPC/KMS) steps.
- Contract timing: legal is reviewing the SOW; we should be able to turn around minor redlines by 6/18, but if there are pricing changes we'll need to re-evaluate.

I'll loop in our infra lead (Luke) to confirm the VPC/KMS timeline. Otherwise, map looks reasonable.

Best,
Emily Johnson
Director, Product Operations — Acme Corp
emily.johnson@acme.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Emily Johnson <emily.johnson@acme.com>, Luke Peterson <luke.peterson@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + post-call recap (Acme rollout)

Emily — thanks. I've incorporated the SOC2/security gate and updated responsibilities in the attached MAP v3 (see highlights). Key updates:

- Security gate: Redwood to provide SOC 2 Type II summary + encryption at-rest confirmation by 6/22. (Attachment: SOW-Acme-Redwood-2026.pdf includes compliance appendix.)
- Provisioning: Redwood infra (owner: Marissa) will own VPC peering and initial KMS handshake; Acme to complete network allow-listing by 6/28.
- Pricing: Ben is CC'd to confirm final numbers; any changes will be communicated by 6/18.

Next steps:
1) Acme legal: please confirm any redlines by 6/18 so we can push to DocuSign.
2) Redwood: deliver SOC2 summary and SOW by 6/22.
3) Finalize MAP and confirm sign-off target 6/25.

Thanks — attaching updated MAP and SOW for review.

Camila
Attachment: Acme_Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf, SOW-Acme-Redwood-2026.pdf

From: Luke Peterson <luke.peterson@acme.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + post-call recap (Acme rollout)

Camila / Emily — quick infra update: we confirm we can do allow-listing and KMS on our end; provisioning window is available 6/26-6/28. That aligns with the MAP targets.

Legal: we've completed a first pass on the SOW; only a minor pricing clarification remains (line item for burst capacity). Ben — can you confirm the final number so we can close legal?

Also confirming the security gate (SOC2 summary) is required before we enable production. If Redwood can deliver by 6/22, we should be good to meet the 6/25 sign-off target.

—Luke

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Hi Emily / Luke —

Thanks for the quick turn-around and for confirming milestone owners. Per the MAP and SOW review, Redwood is ready to proceed:

- SOC 2 Type II summary and encryption-at-rest confirmation: delivered to Acme legal on 2026-06-22.
- Pricing clarification (burst capacity fee): Ben confirmed via internal thread and updated SOW on 6/21 — no change to the committed monthly amount; burst fee optional.
- Provisioning window confirmed for 6/26–6/28.
- Success criteria (latency and accuracy gates) validated during staging tests on 7/02 (test plan attached to SOW).

Next steps after signature:
- Kickoff + onboarding call scheduled for 2026-07-08 10:00 AM PT (invite to follow).
- Primary contacts: Camila Reyes (PE/AM), Marissa Cole (infra ops), Ben Carter (billing).
